subject.title: refactor(core): consolidate plugin install pipeline, migrate worktree ledger, carry prepared runtime metadata

question: Should the supported upgrade contract retire every pre-ledger managed-worktree registry row through Doctor and require fresh provisioning on next use?
rationale: This is an intentional persisted-state behavior change rather than a mechanical refactor: accepting it determines whether older worktree ownership records remain recoverable through the prior restore path.

options.title: Accept Doctor retirement
options.body: Keep the canonical-only runtime design and document that old ledger rows are removed while their checkout and branch files remain untouched.

options.title: Preserve a migration path
options.body: Require a narrower Doctor migration that converts or exports eligible legacy worktree metadata before the old registry row is retired.

recommendation.title: Accept Doctor retirement
recommendation.body: Keep the canonical-only runtime design and document that old ledger rows are removed while their checkout and branch files remain untouched.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch author owns the proposed ledger-retirement contract and its migration tests.
